fullFileReadability.method: Read-only streams through EOF, SHA-256 over all bytes, expected length and modification-time checks; reparse points skipped.

caseFoldedPathCollisions.rule: Slash separators, NFC normalization, invariant lowercase, ordinal comparison across files, directories and links.
caseFoldedPathCollisions.note: Invariant lowercase is the explicit baseline rule; future database collation must be reviewed for Unicode equivalence. All-ASCII inventories avoid this ambiguity.

limitations: Point-in-time reads, not an atomic NAS snapshot or proof of image decoding. Original baseline lacks full-file hashes, so historical byte equality cannot be established beyond recorded metadata and headers.
